metadata.description: Academic research skills for AI agents: find and review the literature in 250 million real papers, develop research ideas, read papers closely, and write, check and revise manuscripts.

plugins.name: researchzy
plugins.description: Find and review the literature with real papers: search about 250 million records, manage your library and PDFs, write literature reviews that cite only what the search returned, and develop research ideas with a logged novelty check. Needs a Researchzy account.

plugins.name: researchzy-reading
plugins.description: Read papers with your agent: lawful full-text downloads, a close reading of one paper, and structured Paper Cards. Works on your own PDFs; no account needed.

plugins.name: researchzy-manuscript
plugins.description: Write, check and revise a manuscript with your agent: plan and draft from your own results, make and check figures, review the paper as its reviewers will, check that references are real, review statistical reporting, draft availability statements and answer reviewers. No account needed.
